name: dependency-security-gate
description: Security gate that intercepts every dependency install or external download (npm/yarn/pnpm/bun/pip/uv/poetry/cargo/gem/brew/apt/dnf/go/pod/curl/wget/aria2c/git clone/huggingface-cli) and forces a structured 11-item security review before allowing the action. Ships a PreToolUse hook, an auto-discoverable skill carrying the analysis structure, and a `dependency-research` subagent that runs parallel Context7 + Exa MCP research with native WebFetch/WebSearch fallbacks when those MCPs are not installed.
